I'll start by reading TASK.md and brief.md so I can follow the brief exactly, with section 0 taking priority.Section 0 limits writes to `work\` and requires T3e's command wrapper. I'll read the background and the T3e scripts before tracing the editor binding.The vtable slot at `0x611a01e8` sits in a 29-byte gap that was never decompiled. I'll disassemble it and search the image for the editor-id binding.The 24-byte table maps `0x1e3` to UI 2154, but nothing in the image points at it. I'll watch those bytes while the page-27 chooser opens and record the instruction that reads them.The lookup is a linear scan of a 416-record table. `0x1e3` is the record whose third word is UI 2154. I'll give `0x3D6F` its own record and run that as the first experiment.The committing run is in hand. The zone-list trials did not put the ten images in the chooser, so the write-up is next.The AF-ON row now has its own editor binding, and confirming the other priority value writes UI `0x3D6F` into RAM byte `0xa031e920`. The ten zone images do not appear in that chooser, so the acceptance run was not started.

`0x611a01e8` only returns the halfword at the object plus `0x54`. The second dispatch word is resolved by `FUN_6124f4e5`, which scans the 416-record key-8 table at `0x615c540c`. A new record, editor id `0x1e6`, copies 2154's record with the UI id set to `0x3D6F`. The table is a runtime write at `0x60320000`: RAM at and above `0x6031f000` is not loaded from the image.

That binding alone opened a blank screen and confirm stored 12. Cloning 2154's editor descriptor (template `0x606190b7`, count 2) and linking it into the hash opened the two priority buttons. Confirm called `0x6041937f` with `(0x3D6F, 1)`, the profile byte became 1, cancel left it 0, and `0x90a1` stayed `[1, 1]`.

Pointing the row at `0x6158ba1c` drew the All grid on the row and left the chooser as the two priority buttons. A one-record text list (value 0, text id `0x0034`, the English string "All") drew the word All on the row and did not change the chooser. The other nine zone values have no text id tied to them here.

`work/result.md` and `work/evidence-manifest.json` are in place. The proposed overlay is `work/out/overlay-changed-bytes.csv`. The binding table and the section-7 pointer writes are runtime writes, described in `work/out/design.md`.
